text:
Alice: quick heads-up — proposing a small, flat set of fields on the /v1/response usage payload to make billing/recon simpler for customers and finance. need a quick compatibility check before I open the PR :white_check_mark:

Ben: do you mean adding new top-level fields in the API response (vs nested usage object)? any example? :eyes:

Alice: yeah, example (proposal):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-4b\",
  \"tokens_prompt\": 120,
  \"tokens_completion\": 80,
  \"cached_tokens_prompt\": 40,
  \"cached_tokens_completion\": 10,
  \"cached_origin\": \"prefix_cache\",
  \"cached_chargeable_tokens\": 30,
  \"billing_schema_version\": \"v2\"
}
```
Semantics: \"cached_chargeable_tokens\" represents tokens we would have charged but were served from cache (so finance = tokens_prompt + tokens_completion - cached_chargeable_tokens).

Carla: hm — we already have `usage` object that some customers rely on. Adding top-level fields will break some ad-hoc parsers. Can we keep the old `usage` and add these as a compatible additive surface?

Ben: +1 to keeping old object. Another option: expose `billing_schema_version` (you included that) so SDKs can detect and fall back. Also consider a single aggregated field `chargeable_tokens` so callers don't need to compute math unless they want to.

Erin: one nuanced thing: batching + prefix caching. For multi-input batches we may count `cached_tokens_prompt` differently. Are these per-request totals or per-sub-item? we should spell that out.

Alice: good call. proposal update: fields are per-API-response (i.e., per request) and additive across items for batches. We'll document that. If caller wants per-item breakdown we can add `items[].usage` later.

acct-bot: Finance note — reconciliation pipeline needs deterministic formula. Please confirm final equation and rounding rule. Current ask: will we always report integers? how do we handle tokenization differences across models? :money_with_wings:

Carla: on tokenization: include `model` and `tokenizer_version` in response to make recon deterministic. And yes, integers only (round down after byte->token heuristics).

Alice: agreed. finalizing fields to include: `tokens_prompt`, `tokens_completion`, `cached_tokens_prompt`, `cached_tokens_completion`, `cached_chargeable_tokens`, `chargeable_tokens` (computed server-side), `billing_schema_version`, `model`, `tokenizer_version`. All ints except strings where appropriate.

Ben: do we also need a `cached_origin` enum for audit (e.g., `prefix_cache`, `kv_cache`, `batch_cache`)? can be string or array if multiple sources applied.

Alice: yes — `cached_origin` will be a short string (primary origin) for now. if multiple origins show up we'll change to a list in v3.

Erin: migration plan:
- Ben opens API + docs PR with sample responses and SDK stubs (this week)
- Add unit tests + a simple reconciler example in docs (Finance)
- Feature-flag rollout behind `billing_schema_version` detection

Ben: on it — creating PR now. assigning self to SDK bumps. ETA end of week.

deploy-bot: Created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123 (WIP: billing v2 fields + docs)

acct-bot: Finance will review the docs once PR is public. FYI we need a small sample CSV mapping for our downstream systems.

Alice: thanks — can someone own the CSV sample? @Carla?

Carla: I can draft the CSV mapping tomorrow. will sync with Finance after PR lands.

Ben: quick Q for API team — are we ok exposing `cached_chargeable_tokens` as a public field or do we gate behind an account flag? customers might treat it as a true-up signal.

Alice: decision: expose by default (transparent accounting). If customers want a different behavior we'll add an account opt-out. call it out in the changelog.

Erin: also add `billing_schema_version` to SDK response model so users can feature-detect.

Alice: noted. PR will include SDK interface note and an example Node snippet showing detection.

Ben: short note — I'll also add a reconcile snippet showing `server_chargeable = chargeable_tokens` and the formula we discussed.

Alice: perfect. thanks all. will merge once tests + docs are green. planning rollout next Tue unless we find major issues. :rocket:
